title: The Unicode Standard, Version 18.0.0, Chapter 6: Writing Systems and Punctuation (6.2 General Punctuation, Apostrophes)
author: The Unicode Consortium
usedFor: The difference between U+2019 RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK (preferred for a punctuation apostrophe) and U+02BC MODIFIER LETTER APOSTROPHE (preferred where the apostrophe is a modifier letter), and the note that U+2019 between letters does not separate words.
